current_focus.domain: Better Auth merchant routes on Cloudflare Workers and D1
current_focus.summary: Normalize accepted root http(s) configured MERCHANT_BASE_URL to canonical origin at the binding boundary so Better Auth baseURL/trustedOrigins and custom CSRF compare the same origin. Preserve fail-closed secret/base, credentials/query/hash, and unsupported scheme/path. Missing or foreign Origin still 403. Add actual built-worker regressions: configured trailing slash plus valid origin succeeds; foreign/missing origins rejected; malformed configuration fails 503. Prove the regression fails before the fix, then minimal fix and full npm run verify on Node 22.23.2. Leave merchant-better-auth-008 IMPLEMENTED for parent public proof. No pages, copy, migrations, packages, workflows, store protocol, screenshots, public proof, commit, push, merge, deploy, or review-rail actions.

decisions.rationale: Bobby instructed proceed in response to the public-only launch recommendation. Merges and live deployment still require separate approval after current formal reviews and account/domain verification.

decisions.choice: Native CMS signup still uses operator-allowed domains. A custom AuthAdapter can implement public getAllowedDomain for general SUBSCRIBER signup without domain rows or internals. Use exported requestSignup/completeSignup/sendMagicLink/verifyMagicLink through that adapter. SignupConfig cannot configure native CMS URLs; record that coupling without calling the helpers internal. Native tokens remain opaque CMS credentials, not service JWTs. Keep DinkusKit-owned account IDs, site-control-before-grant, and a narrow proof-labeled JWT bridge. Do not ship homemade signup/session as a product auth platform or add a public login route. Native browser/provider integration remains unproven; recommend Better Auth as the next maintained provider proof.
